intro.en: Measurement cables preserve low-level, precision and high-bandwidth signals between sensors and instruments.
intro.zh: 测量仪器电缆在传感器与仪器之间保持低电平、精密与高带宽信号。

knowledge.en: Resistance, capacitance, leakage, noise, impedance and motion can all change the measurement.
knowledge.zh: 电阻、电容、泄漏、噪声、阻抗与运动都可能改变测量结果。

notes.en: Provide sensor, range, bandwidth, accuracy, route, connectors and calibration boundary.
notes.zh: 请提供传感器、量程、带宽、精度、路径、接口与校准边界。

delivery.en: Release records the configured measurement lead and agreed evidence.
delivery.zh: 放行记录包含实际配置测量引线与约定证据。

subtitle.en: Preserve the measurand from sensor interface to instrument input
subtitle.zh: 从传感接口到仪器输入，保持被测量的真实性

lead.en: Define the complete measurement path before construction.
lead.zh: 制造前定义完整测量路径。
